technique_name: Compose a report about the impact of global warming on the Arctic region.
description: The Arctic region has been significantly affected by global warming. The average temperature in the Arctic has risen twice as more as the rest of the world and the entire region is now estimated to be two to four degrees warmer than it was a few decades ago. This has had a profound effect on the Arctic ecosystem, leading to the melting of sea ice, forest fires, coastal erosion, and changes in animal migration patterns.
